title: Axioma Cancrizans: Interactive Euclidean Polyrhythm & Topological Canon Studio
narrative: Contemporary algorithmic composers and music theorists struggle to compose complex contrapuntal canons over Euclidean polyrhythmic timelines. Standard linear piano-roll DAWs obscure cyclic dihedral symmetry D_n and hide topological voice crossings. Manual Bjorklund distribution and canon transformations introduce unnoticed parallel fifths and voice collisions. Axioma Cancrizans unifies non-Euclidean rhythm necklaces, dihedral canon folding, and species counterpoint verification into an interactive, formally certified studio.
